connection: Follow a waffle from the hot iron to a plate with berries.
See how oats turn up in a warm breakfast bowl and in a batch of chewy cookies.
One scene stirs tomato soup on the stove. The other brings a covered pot to the table.
Look for robins on the lawn after rain and for their eggs in a spring nest.
Watch a duck feed in the water, then look at what a duck leaves behind in wet sand.
Try two familiar moments with a dog at home: drying its paws at the door and setting out supper.
Visit two stops for backyard birds, a place to splash and a place to find seeds.
See how a woodpecker holds on to a pole and what it can find on a tree trunk.
Look at the same water surface in two ways: ripples coming from a creek and bubbles rising from below.
